plugins.name: pensions-adviser
plugins.description: Unofficial UK adaptation of Anthropic's Claude for Financial Advisors plugin, reworked for FCA-authorised pensions and retirement advisers and paraplanners: annual review prep, meeting write-ups, FCA financial-promotion and Consumer Duty pre-checks, pension statement intake, pension transfer fact-finding with safeguarded-benefit and scam flags, retirement income (drawdown) reviews, portfolio reviews, and death-benefit and allowances briefs. It holds no client data, and the adviser approves any write back to an external system. Claude gathers, organises, summarises and compares; the adviser exercises judgement and gives the advice. For use by professionals at FCA-authorised firms only; not financial, tax, legal or regulated advice. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
